_comment: ares-signal-fusion configuration. ALL weights/thresholds/half-lives live here; signal_fusion.py hot-reloads on SIGHUP. Values are the initial spec values from SIGNAL_FUSION_PROMPT.md — self-calibration REPORTS suggested changes after >=20 resolved picks but never edits this file itself.
_wallet_reputation_comment: wallet_learner.py's copy_trade_score (Vantage wallet_reputation table) boosts a wallet's positive quality in s_wallet, log-normalized against the log cap then capped at max_quality -- never overrides a negative tag.
_independence_comment: S_independence discounts a token's buyer COUNT by what actually caused it: entity-graph ring members collapse to one buyer, wallets sharing a funder collapse to one actor, and identical amounts across many buyers read as a distribution rather than a market. correlated_whale_min_independence is the floor below which the correlated-whale bonus in S_finding is suppressed rather than paid -- a cluster is only evidence while it is real, and paying a bonus for manufactured width while S_independence discounts it would charge the same fact twice in opposite directions.
